name: document
description: No RPC surface at all: the agent gets the document FORMAT and one tool that swallows a whole project. Exists because vcad's mecheval found that emitting their document format in one shot beat driving their MCP API on matched tiers (a2 100% vs 72%, a4 82% vs 42%) — and every arm we have goes through the API, so none of them can see whether ours is a help or a tax. If this arm wins, the finding is about our surface, not about this agent.
